scope: Conditional uncertainty under the selected coupled mean, hard conductance band and quantized observation law; all model selection used these data

lower_loading_sensitivity.reason: Repeated lower-bound sensor-loading estimates and the theoretical sensor/input lag exchange at zero loading; assess dependence on the original 0.005 lower bound before assigning physical lag identities.

recovery.coverage_definition: Refit unconstrained and true-log-K constrained models for each generated record collection; fraction with twice-nll difference <= nominal chi-square-one cutoff. This empirically checks that cutoff with nuisance bounds, conditional on the generating model and design.
recovery.denominators: Retain every attempted draw, failure, retry and local-basin correction. Report coverage among complete draws, binomial Monte Carlo uncertainty and worst-case bounds counting failed draws either way.
recovery.expansion: No expansion to 200 until numerical convergence and the 50-draw diagnostic review justify it.
